news.title: trunk/1776b988238f9978a57690ad7e9b37bff539555c: [MPS] Replace MPSGraph max_pool2d forward with Metal kernels (#201756)
news.dek: The generic  max_pool  Metal kernel decomposes the thread id with per-dim div/mod by runtime sizes and is ~8x slower than memory bandwidth allows. That is why stride-1  max_pool2d  was routed to MPSGraph, which silently drops NaNs. The Metal kernel dropped them too, unless a NaN
news.aiSummary: The generic max_pool Metal kernel was found to be approximately 8x slower than memory bandwidth limits due to inefficient thread ID decomposition. Consequently, stride-1 max_pool2d operations were previously routed to MPSGraph, which silently drops NaNs. This change replaces the MPSGraph forward pass with optimized Metal kernels to address performance issues and handle NaNs correctly.
